objective: Complete source-specific TED product admission and connect the authenticated tenant-scoped ResearchRun loop to governed procurement evidence, claims and dossiers in InvestigationContext.
outcome: A verified organisation can create a persistent ResearchRun from Navigator, observe bounded progress, receive a source-linked procurement dossier and admitted claim state in InvestigationContext, and replay or roll back the workflow without fixture authority, tenant leakage or model-written canonical truth.

skills.activation_reason: Resolve the exact TED rights, attribution, retention, display and revocation boundary before product use.
Promote only the admitted TED profiles into bounded persistent execution.
Keep Evidence Objects, Candidate Claims and canonical admission distinct.
Wire identity, tenant, ResearchRun persistence, worker execution and InvestigationContext resources.
Verify server-side tenancy, permissions, credentials, queues and export boundaries.
Preserve personal-data minimisation and tenant isolation across source and document processing.
Prove E2E progress, retry, idempotency, replay, rollback and source kill-switch behaviour.
Prevent technical evidence from being represented as product admission without complete gates.

allowed_scope: Authenticated identity and server-side tenant resolution
Polling or SSE progress with resumable state
Worker processing of admitted TED source and documents
Deterministic admission and bounded human review
Dossier and claim return to InvestigationContext
Source, tenant and workflow kill switches
prohibited_scope: Supplier suitability, win probability, margin or legal conclusions

acceptance_evidence.description: Exact TED commercial-use, storage, transformation, display, export, attribution, personal-data and revocation dimensions are accepted for the promoted profile.
Authenticated tenant-scoped E2E tests prove ResearchRun creation, progress, completion, dossier return and isolation; retry and expiry remain part of final gate closure.
acceptance_evidence.location: GitHub Actions run 30465908324, TED Product Runtime

acceptance_evidence.description: Frozen run 8ee635e1-3187-4147-8d17-d83f2f97bc3 links two TED notices to seven Evidence Objects, seven Candidate Claims, seven deterministic canonical Claims and an attributed dossier; cross-tenant read is blocked by RLS and model calls equal zero.
Tenant, queue, credential, export and kill-switch boundaries pass independent review.
Measured latency, source completeness, processing cost, failure rate and rollback residue satisfy the F8 profile.
A qualified B2G user completes the opportunity-to-evidence workflow and understands the authority boundary.

rollback.strategy: Disable the TED product source and ResearchRun procurement route, return the UI to the last accepted bounded fixture or read-only evidence state, and preserve append-only audit history.
rollback.kill_switch: Per-source and per-workflow kill switches stop new execution without deleting prior evidence; focused tests prove both gates fail closed.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The task completes the selected global-discovery wedge through a real professional workflow.
Every material procurement claim remains linked to official evidence and versioned admission.
The same InvestigationContext can drive Navigator, Globe, Graph, Timeline and dossier surfaces.
User intent cannot create procurement truth or bypass source admission.
Original source language and values remain recoverable with explicit translation provenance.
Persistent evidence, lifecycle and dossier state create defence beyond generic summarisation.
The workflow prepares pursue, monitor or decline research without executing or recommending a bid.
Rights, privacy, tenancy, security and authority gates are explicit acceptance evidence.
Source and workflow kill switches plus rollback are mandatory.
This is the highest-value next transition after the accepted F8 lifecycle evidence.
